sources: Seeded from data/patches/7.2a; unstamped values carry over unchanged and retain their prior provenance and verification status.
Every value changed in this roll was cross-confirmed against BOTH sources above (Riot primary + wildriftfire), with no discrepancies.

verified: false — 7.2b is a PARTIAL roll. 15 of the patch's 24 documented changes are representable and were applied; the remaining 9 touch mechanics the schema does not model (shields, heals, ability mana costs, %-missing-health and %-health-lost damage, passive move-speed and damage-reduction effects) or systems with no data file at all (runes, champion bounty). See ROSTER.md "Patch 7.2b". The flag stays false because carried-over 7.2/7.2a values remain unverified, not because of this patch's own changes.

Tear-line backfill (hand-run, 2026-08-06): added Tear of the Goddess, Muramana, and Seraph's Embrace, and applied the 7.2b Lord Dominik's Regards change that the original roll skipped. Correction to the original roll's note: Lord Dominik's Regards was NEVER absent — it was in the dataset under the singular name "Lord Dominik's Regard", which is why two passes read it as missing. Its `name` is now the plural Riot uses; its `id` stays `lord-dominiks-regard` because data/patches/7.1/builds.json references it.

Per-value sourcing for the backfill. Tear cost 500 / mana 200 / abilityHaste 5: Riot 7.2 (900→500, 300→200, 10→5) + LoL Wiki WR; Mana Charge +5/stack: Riot 7.2a (6→5). Seraph's abilityPower 60 + abilityHaste 25 + Awe 2% max mana + Lifeline 20% max mana: Riot 7.2 (35→60, 20→25, Awe 3%→2%, Lifeline 15%→20%, CD 90s→70s); Lifeline then 20%→16%: Riot 7.2a; cost 3000 / mana 1200 / magicPenPercent 0.07 cross-checked against Archangel's Staff, which Seraph's transforms from at +0 gold (500 base mana + 700 stacked = 1200). Muramana cost 2700 / attackDamage 25 / abilityHaste 20 / mana 1000: LoL Wiki WR + lolwildriftbuild.com, and internally consistent with Manamune (300 base mana + 700 stacked); Shock AD ratio 4.5%: Riot 7.2a (6%→4.5%). Lord Dominik's Regards attackDamage 25→30: Riot 7.2b + LoL Wiki WR (which confirms the pre-change 25).

Tear-line completion (same hand-run pass): added Fimbulwinter (Winter's Approach at max stacks) — cost 2600, maxHealth 350, abilityHaste 15, mana 1200 (= Winter's Approach's 500 base + 700 stacked), cross-confirmed by LoL Wiki WR + lolwildriftbuild.com. Unstamped, like Winter's Approach, because no source establishes when those values last changed. All seven Tear-line items now carry exclusiveGroup "tear", modelling the in-game rule "Limited to 1 Tear of the Goddess item" (LoL Wiki WR item text, corroborated by zilliongamer); the three transforms also carry upgradesFrom. Without this a build could stack Tear + Manamune + Muramana and report mana totals the game cannot produce.

Fimbulwinter Awe ratio is CONTESTED and the value shown (10% maximum mana) is the LoL Wiki WR figure; lolwildriftbuild.com says 8%, matching Winter's Approach's un-upgraded ratio. Not resolvable from available sources. Descriptive text only — no engine effect — and the wiki was the more reliable of the two throughout this pass (lolwildriftbuild's Muramana Shock text is provably stale). Flagged rather than silently picked.

Known single-source / omitted values in the backfill. (1) Muramana's Awe ratio (2% maximum mana, vs Manamune's 1.5%) rests on LoL Wiki WR alone — lolwildriftbuild.com says 1.5%, but its Shock text has no AD term at all and so cannot be reconciled with Riot's 7.2a "Muramana Shock: Attack Damage ratio" line, marking it stale. Descriptive text only; no engine effect. (2) Seraph's Lifeline flat shield component (the pre-7.2 wiki text read "100 + 15% current mana") is OMITTED rather than guessed: Riot's 7.2 rework restates Lifeline as a max-mana conversion and no reachable source confirms a flat term survives it. (3) riftgg.app returned HTTP 403 on every attempt, so the CLAUDE.md priority-2 pair was covered by wildriftfire's patch notes plus the official LoL Wiki WR namespace instead.
